message.content: The purpose of running llama-server rather than only a command-line model is to enable LLM inference with minimal setup and achieve state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of tasks. The server is lightweight, OpenAI API compatible, and serves LLMs via HTTP. It includes a basic web UI that can be accessed via the browser, and supports multiple users and parallel decoding. The server can also enable speculative decoding. To run llama-server, you need to provide a model file in the GGUF format and specify the port number. The server requires the model to be stored in the GGUF file format. Models in other data formats can be converted to GGUF using the convert_*.py Python scripts in this repo. The Hugging Face platform offers tools for converting, quantizing, and hosting models with llama.cpp.
